name: pdf-image-text-extractor
description: Extract text from PDFs and images with format preservation and table detection

interface.shortDescription: Extract text from PDFs and images with format preservation and table detection
interface.longDescription: OCR text extractor for PDFs and images. Zero extra dependencies: scanned PDFs are auto-rendered to images and processed by AI vision (no tesseract/rapidocr needed); tables extracted via pymupdf's built-in find_tables (no pdfplumber needed); supports batch directory processing (PDFs + images in one shot). Preserves original formatting and outputs structured Markdown.
defaultPrompt: Extract text from PDFs and images with format preservation and table detection
